categories.name: On-chain Gaming
categories.content: On-chain games refer to games where all components, including game logic, assets, interactions, and characteristics, are stored directly on the blockchain.

categories.name: TokenFi Launchpad
categories.content: TokenFi Launchpad is a platform for crypto projects to hold Initial DEX Offerings (IDOs). Participants are able to gain early access to public and special token sales on the platform.

categories.name: Reserve Ecosystem
categories.content: Decentralized Token Folio (DTF) issued and created with the Reserve protocol's open-source contracts (developed by ABC Labs).

categories.name: RPG
categories.content: Role-playing game (RPG) is a video game genre where players control a single or group of character in a fictional world. RPG games typically include elements of storytelling, character development, exploration, quests, and inventory management.

categories.name: Dinari Ecosystem
categories.content: The Dinari Ecosystem comprises tokens tokenized by Dinari.

categories.name: Tokenized Assets
categories.content: Tokenized products refers to digital representation of assets on a blockchain platform.

categories.name: Telegram Apps
categories.content: Applications built on the Telegram platform that integrate cryptocurrency or blockchain technology.

categories.name: OpenServ Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokens launched on OpenServ, a multi-chain crowdfunding platform designed for autonomous startups and Agentic Applications (aApps) built on OpenServ’s AI reasoning infrastructure.

categories.name: Real World Assets (RWA)
categories.content: Real World Assets (RWAs) refer to tangible or physical assets that have value in the real world. The tokenization of RWAs involves representing these assets digitally on a blockchain, allowing for fractional ownership, increased liquidity, and more efficient management and trading of these assets.

categories.name: Venice Ecosystem
categories.content: Venice is a decentralized, privacy-first AI network that provides permissionless and uncensored access to Large Language Models (LLMs) through a distributed compute architecture.

categories.name: BagsApp Ecosystem
categories.content: BagsApp Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via bags.fm.

categories.name: Buidlpad Launchpad
categories.content: Buidlpad is a launchpad that enables token sales with KYC-verified participants.

categories.name: BONK.fun Ecosystem
categories.content: LetsBONK.fun Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via letsbonk.fun.

categories.name: Play To Earn
categories.content: Play to Earn games are built on the blockchain, giving players full control over their gaming accounts and related assets, which they can sell on exchanges or secondary marketplaces.

categories.name: Pons Launchpad
categories.content: Tokens launched on pons (https://ponsfamily.com/launchpad).

categories.name: Emoji-Themed

categories.name: BackedFi xStocks Ecosystem
categories.content: xStocks refers to the tokenized stocks and ETFs issued by BackedFi.

categories.name: Farming Games
categories.content: Farming game allows players to simulate farming life, focusing on activities such as planting and harvesting crops, raising livestock, and managing resources.

categories.name: Camelot Launchpad
categories.content: Camelot Launchpad is a platform for crypto projects to hold Initial DEX Offerings (IDOs). Participants are able to gain early access to public and special token sales on the platform.

categories.name: Metaverse
categories.content: The metaverse refers to a digital world where participants can interact with each other in a shared virtual reality.
